findings.title: Session ID path validation has no regression test
findings.description: The new guard protects the recording commands from session IDs that could escape their per-session directory, but the change adds no tests and the repository has no existing test files. Add coverage for empty and traversal/separator-containing IDs through the recording command boundary, along with a valid ID case; otherwise removing or weakening this validation can silently reintroduce path writes outside the intended session directory.

findings.title: Blocking sleep inside async OAuth command
findings.description: `google_drive_connect` is an async Tauri command, but its callback-poll loop blocks a Tokio runtime worker for 200 ms on every iteration, potentially for the full 120-second timeout. While sign-in is pending this ties up a worker and can delay unrelated async commands; use an async timer or move the blocking listener wait to a blocking task.

findings.title: Add a test for the exported environment helper
findings.description: PROJECT_RULES.md R-16 says: "Every new public function, command, or component with logic must have a test in the same change; a bug fix must add a test that fails before the fix." This change exports `isTauri` as a shared public helper, but the change contains no test files. Add a test covering the browser and Tauri detection cases. Verified with `git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD` (no test files) and `git show HEAD:PROJECT_RULES.md` (R-16).

findings.title: Widget listeners accumulate between recording sessions
findings.description: Each call to handleRecord registers two Tauri listeners and discards their unsubscribe functions. Cancel leaves this page mounted, so starting and canceling multiple sessions stacks callbacks; later stop or cancel events invoke callbacks from prior sessions as well. Keep the unlisten functions and release them when the session ends, or register a single pair for the page lifetime.

findings.title: Expired tokens still make desktop Drive uploads fail
findings.description: When a connected desktop app uploads after its access token expires, execution takes the `isTauri()` branch above and sends the saved token directly to `upload_to_drive`; this expiry check and refresh only run in browser mode. The Rust upload command returns the 401 as an error without refreshing, so desktop users cannot upload until they reconnect despite the new expiry tracking.

findings.title: Widget listener can outlive its component
findings.description: If the widget unmounts before the dynamic import resolves, cleanup observes `unlistenPromise` as null and returns. The async setup then resumes and registers the listener without any remaining cleanup path, leaving a global callback that can mutate stale component state on later events.
